## How I tested it

- [ ] `node --test` and `python3 -m unittest discover -s tools` pass
- [ ] Tried it in herdr (`./install.sh`), or explained why not needed
- [ ] Changed art? Edited `tools/sprites.py` and ran `python3 tools/sprites.py` (never the SVGs by hand)
- [ ] Changed behaviour? README, RECIPE.md and CHANGELOG updated
